name: CIS Controls v8.1
description: Prioritized set of actions to protect organizations from known cyber attack vectors
scope: Any organization — Implementation Groups IG1 (basic) through IG3 (advanced)

families.name: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
families.description: Actively manage all enterprise assets connected to the infrastructure

controls.name: Establish Asset Inventory
controls.description: Establish and maintain a detailed enterprise asset inventory

controls.name: Address Unauthorized Assets
controls.description: Ensure unauthorized assets are either removed, denied access, or quarantined

controls.name: Portable End-User Devices
controls.description: Utilize an active discovery tool to identify portable end-user devices

controls.name: Use DHCP Logging
controls.description: Use DHCP logging to update the enterprise asset inventory

controls.name: Passive Asset Discovery
controls.description: Use a passive discovery tool to identify assets on the network

families.name: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
families.description: Actively manage all software on the network to ensure only authorized software is installed

controls.name: Establish Software Inventory
controls.description: Establish and maintain a detailed inventory of all licensed software

controls.name: Authorized Software Only
controls.description: Ensure only currently supported software is used on enterprise assets

controls.name: Address Unauthorized Software
controls.description: Ensure unauthorized software is removed or its installation is prevented

controls.name: Allowlist Authorized Software
controls.description: Use application allowlisting to control software execution

controls.name: Allowlist Authorized Libraries
controls.description: Use allowlisting for authorized libraries and scripts

families.name: Data Protection
families.description: Develop processes and technical controls to identify, classify, handle, retain, and dispose of data

controls.name: Establish Data Management Process
controls.description: Establish and maintain a data management process including classification

controls.name: Establish Data Inventory
controls.description: Establish and maintain a data inventory based on data classification

controls.name: Data Retention
controls.description: Establish and maintain a data retention process with minimum/maximum retention

controls.name: Enforce Data Retention
controls.description: Retain data according to established retention process and securely dispose of data

controls.name: Encrypt Data on End-User Devices
controls.description: Encrypt data on end-user devices containing sensitive data

controls.name: Encrypt Sensitive Data in Transit
controls.description: Encrypt sensitive data in transit using TLS

controls.name: Encrypt Sensitive Data at Rest
controls.description: Encrypt sensitive data at rest on servers and databases

controls.name: Segment Data Processing
controls.description: Segment data based on sensitivity on separate networks or processing environments

controls.name: Log Sensitive Data Access
controls.description: Log access to sensitive data including modification and disposal

families.name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
families.description: Establish and maintain secure configuration of enterprise assets and software

controls.name: Establish Secure Configuration Process
controls.description: Establish and maintain a secure configuration process for enterprise assets

controls.name: Establish Network Configuration Process
controls.description: Establish and maintain a secure configuration process for network infrastructure

controls.name: Manage Default Accounts
controls.description: Manage default accounts on enterprise assets and software

controls.name: Uninstall or Disable Unnecessary Services
controls.description: Uninstall or disable unnecessary services on enterprise assets

families.name: Account Management
families.description: Use processes and tools to assign and manage credentials for user accounts

controls.name: Establish Account Inventory
controls.description: Establish and maintain an inventory of all accounts

controls.name: Use Unique Passwords
controls.description: Use unique passwords for all enterprise assets where MFA is not supported

controls.name: Disable Dormant Accounts
controls.description: Delete or disable dormant accounts after a period of inactivity

controls.name: Restrict Admin Privileges
controls.description: Restrict administrator privileges to dedicated administrator accounts

controls.name: Centralize Account Management
controls.description: Centralize account management through a directory or identity service

families.name: Access Control Management
families.description: Use processes and tools to create, assign, manage, and revoke access credentials

controls.name: Establish Access Granting Process
controls.description: Establish and follow a process for granting access to enterprise assets

controls.name: Establish Access Revoking Process
controls.description: Establish and follow a process for revoking access to enterprise assets

controls.name: Require MFA for External Applications
controls.description: Require MFA for externally-exposed applications

controls.name: Require MFA for Remote Access
controls.description: Require MFA for remote network access

controls.name: Require MFA for Admin Access
controls.description: Require MFA for all administrative access accounts

controls.name: Define and Maintain Role-Based Access
controls.description: Define and maintain role-based access control with least privilege

families.name: Continuous Vulnerability Management
families.description: Develop a plan to continuously assess and track vulnerabilities on enterprise assets

controls.name: Establish Vulnerability Management Process
controls.description: Establish and maintain a documented vulnerability management process

controls.name: Establish Remediation Process
controls.description: Establish and maintain a risk-based remediation strategy with prioritized timeframes

controls.name: Perform Automated OS Patch Management
controls.description: Perform automated operating system patch management monthly or more

controls.name: Perform Automated Application Patch Management
controls.description: Perform automated application patch management monthly or more

controls.name: Internal Vulnerability Scanning
controls.description: Perform automated vulnerability scans of internal assets quarterly or more

controls.name: External Vulnerability Scanning
controls.description: Perform automated vulnerability scans of externally-exposed assets

controls.name: Remediate Detected Vulnerabilities
controls.description: Remediate detected vulnerabilities in software through patching or other methods

families.name: Audit Log Management
families.description: Collect, alert, review, and retain audit logs of events that could detect or recover from attack

controls.name: Establish Audit Log Management Process
controls.description: Establish and maintain an audit log management process

controls.name: Collect Audit Logs
controls.description: Collect audit logs from enterprise assets covering all required events

controls.name: Collect DNS Query Logs
controls.description: Collect DNS query audit logs on enterprise assets

controls.name: Centralize Audit Logs
controls.description: Centralize audit logs to a log management system for analysis

controls.name: Conduct Audit Log Reviews
controls.description: Conduct reviews of audit logs to detect anomalies or events

families.name: Email and Web Browser Protections
families.description: Improve protections and detections of threats from email and web vectors

controls.name: Ensure Only Supported Browsers and Email Clients
controls.description: Ensure only fully supported browsers and email clients are allowed

controls.name: Use DNS Filtering
controls.description: Use DNS filtering services to block access to known malicious domains

controls.name: Block Unnecessary File Types
controls.description: Block unnecessary file types from email gateway and web downloads

families.name: Malware Defenses
families.description: Prevent or control the installation, spread, and execution of malicious applications

controls.name: Deploy Anti-Malware Software
controls.description: Deploy and maintain anti-malware software on all enterprise assets

controls.name: Configure Anti-Malware Auto-Updates
controls.description: Configure automatic updates for anti-malware signature files

controls.name: Configure Anti-Malware Scanning
controls.description: Configure anti-malware software to automatically scan removable media

controls.name: Use Behavior-Based Anti-Malware
controls.description: Use behavior-based anti-malware software

families.name: Data Recovery
families.description: Establish and maintain data recovery practices for restoring enterprise assets

controls.name: Establish Data Recovery Process
controls.description: Establish and maintain a data recovery process with backup scope and schedule

controls.name: Perform Automated Backups
controls.description: Perform automated backups of in-scope enterprise assets

controls.name: Protect Recovery Data
controls.description: Protect recovery data with encryption or equivalent security controls

controls.name: Establish Isolated Recovery
controls.description: Establish and maintain an isolated instance of recovery data using offline or cloud methods

controls.name: Test Data Recovery
controls.description: Test backup recovery quarterly or more frequently for selected assets

families.name: Network Infrastructure Management
families.description: Establish and maintain secure network device management and architecture

controls.name: Ensure Network Infrastructure is Up-to-Date
controls.description: Ensure network infrastructure is kept up-to-date with latest patches

controls.name: Establish Secure Network Architecture
controls.description: Establish and maintain a secure network architecture

controls.name: Use Secure Network Management
controls.description: Use secure protocols and strong authentication for network management

families.name: Network Monitoring and Defense
families.description: Operate processes to establish and maintain comprehensive network monitoring and defense

controls.name: Centralize Security Event Alerting
controls.description: Centralize security event alerting across enterprise assets

controls.name: Deploy Network Intrusion Detection
controls.description: Deploy a network intrusion detection solution on network segments

controls.name: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.description: Collect network traffic flow logs and/or network traffic

controls.name: Deploy Network Intrusion Prevention
controls.description: Deploy a network intrusion prevention solution

controls.name: Tune Security Event Alerting Thresholds
controls.description: Tune security event alerting thresholds periodically

families.name: Security Awareness and Skills Training
families.description: Establish and maintain a security awareness program to influence behavior

controls.name: Establish Security Awareness Program
controls.description: Establish and maintain a security awareness program

controls.name: Train Workforce on Social Engineering
controls.description: Train workforce members to recognize social engineering attacks

controls.name: Train on Authentication Best Practices
controls.description: Train workforce on the importance of strong authentication

controls.name: Train on Recognizing and Reporting Incidents
controls.description: Train workforce to recognize and report potential security incidents

controls.name: Conduct Role-Specific Training
controls.description: Conduct role-specific security training based on job function

families.name: Service Provider Management
families.description: Develop a process to evaluate service providers who hold sensitive data

controls.name: Establish Service Provider Inventory
controls.description: Establish and maintain an inventory of service providers

controls.name: Establish Service Provider Policy
controls.description: Establish and maintain a service provider management policy

controls.name: Classify Service Providers
controls.description: Classify service providers based on sensitivity of data they handle

controls.name: Include Security in Provider Contracts
controls.description: Ensure service provider contracts include security requirements

controls.name: Securely Decommission Service Providers
controls.description: Securely decommission service providers including data return and destruction

families.name: Application Software Security
families.description: Manage the security life cycle of in-house developed, hosted, or acquired software

controls.name: Establish Secure Application Development Process
controls.description: Establish and maintain a secure application development process

controls.name: Establish Secure Coding Practices
controls.description: Establish and maintain a process to accept and address software vulnerabilities

controls.name: Establish Security Requirements for Third-Party Software
controls.description: Establish security requirements in development or procurement contracts

controls.name: Maintain Third-Party Component Inventory
controls.description: Maintain an inventory of third-party components used in development

controls.name: Train Developers in Secure Coding
controls.description: Ensure developers receive application security training

controls.name: Implement Code-Level Security Checks
controls.description: Implement code-level security checks in the software development pipeline

families.name: Incident Response Management
families.description: Establish a program to develop and maintain an incident response capability

controls.name: Designate Incident Response Personnel
controls.description: Designate one key person and at least one backup to manage incident response

controls.name: Establish Incident Reporting Process
controls.description: Establish and maintain contact information for reporting security incidents

controls.name: Establish Incident Response Process
controls.description: Establish and maintain an enterprise process for incident response

controls.name: Assign Incident Response Roles
controls.description: Assign key roles and responsibilities for incident response

controls.name: Define Communication Mechanisms
controls.description: Determine which primary and secondary communication mechanisms will be used during incidents

controls.name: Conduct Routine Incident Response Exercises
controls.description: Conduct routine incident response exercises at least annually

controls.name: Conduct Post-Incident Reviews
controls.description: Conduct post-incident reviews to improve the incident response process

families.name: Penetration Testing
families.description: Test the effectiveness of controls by simulating attacker objectives and actions

controls.name: Establish Penetration Testing Program
controls.description: Establish and maintain a penetration testing program appropriate to size and complexity

controls.name: Perform External Penetration Tests
controls.description: Perform periodic external penetration tests based on program requirements

controls.name: Remediate Penetration Test Findings
controls.description: Remediate penetration test findings based on prioritized remediation strategy

controls.name: Validate Security Measures
controls.description: Validate security measures after each penetration test

controls.name: Perform Internal Penetration Tests
controls.description: Perform periodic internal penetration tests

changes_summary: Added mobile device and cloud-specific safeguards, updated asset classes, refined Implementation Group assignments, improved mapping to other frameworks
